scripts.description:
Migration from System.Reporting 2.x to 3.0.0 (AB#6176, Epic AB#6171). Intentionally empty.

3.0.0 is a major because the file system types FileSystemEntity, FileSystemContainer,
FileSystemItem, Folder and FolderRoot and the attribute Content move out of this model to the
platform model System.Files 1.0.0 (owned by the asset repository, imported into every tenant).
The data of those types is NOT moved by this migration: the asset repository's file sweep
(AB#6175) moves the entities, associations and GridFS owner stamps to System.Files. Reporting
only keeps ConnectionInfo.

Why the script exists at all (AB#4924 / G3): the CK engine refuses the post-chain schema-only
bridge across a major version (CkMigrationMajorVersionGuard). This empty step is the explicit
statement that 2.x -> 3.0.0 needs no data transform of its own.

Rollout order (concept AB#6171 section 8.7): import 3.0.0 into a tenant only after the file
sweep has run there and the apps of the tenant query System.Files; until then the old types
stay in System.Reporting 2.3.0.

attributes.description: Connection string of a shared report data connection. Stored encrypted; write the plaintext, reads only report whether it is set. The reporting service reveals it in process for the report designer and engine.
